description: 对话练习：Story time + Cartoon time 完整对话，角色扮演跟读

lines.speaker: Liu Tao
lines.english: What's your plan for the weekend, Su Hai?
lines.chinese: 苏海，你周末有什么计划？

lines.speaker: Su Hai
lines.english: I'll go plogging with my family.
lines.chinese: 我要和家人一起去慢跑捡垃圾。

lines.speaker: Liu Tao
lines.english: Plogging? What's that?
lines.chinese: 慢跑捡垃圾？那是什么？

lines.speaker: Su Hai
lines.english: It's jogging and picking up rubbish at the same time.
lines.chinese: 就是同时慢跑和捡垃圾。

lines.speaker: Su Hai
lines.english: It can keep us healthy and make our city clean.
lines.chinese: 它既能让我们保持健康，又能让城市变干净。

lines.speaker: Liu Tao
lines.english: That sounds great! Can I join you?
lines.chinese: 听起来很棒！我能加入你们吗？

lines.speaker: Su Hai
lines.english: Sure! Let's meet at the school gate at nine o'clock on Saturday morning.
lines.chinese: 当然可以！我们周六上午九点在学校门口集合吧。

lines.speaker: Liu Tao
lines.english: OK. I'll be there on time.
lines.chinese: 好的。我会准时到的。

lines.speaker: Su Hai
lines.english: See you then.
lines.chinese: 到时候见。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: On Saturday morning, Su Hai, Su Yang and Liu Tao met at the school gate.
lines.chinese: 周六上午，苏海、苏洋和刘涛在学校门口集合。

lines.speaker: Su Hai
lines.english: Here are rubbish bags. Let's go plogging in the park!
lines.chinese: 这是垃圾袋。我们去公园里慢跑捡垃圾吧！

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: They jogged and picked up rubbish together.
lines.chinese: 他们一起慢跑，一起捡垃圾。

lines.speaker: Liu Tao
lines.english: We did a great job!
lines.chinese: 我们干得太棒了！

lines.speaker: Su Hai
lines.english: Let's go plogging again next weekend!
lines.chinese: 我们下周末再去慢跑捡垃圾吧！

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: Our city is clean and beautiful.
lines.chinese: 我们的城市干净又美丽。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Me too! I love our city.
lines.chinese: 我也这么觉得！我爱我们的城市。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: Bobby throws a banana skin on the ground.
lines.chinese: Bobby把一块香蕉皮扔在了地上。

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: Bobby, don't throw the banana skin on the ground! It makes the street dirty.
lines.chinese: Bobby，不要把香蕉皮扔在地上！它把街道弄脏了。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: I'm sorry. I'll pick it up.
lines.chinese: 对不起。我来把它捡起来。

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.english: But it was too late. Willy slipped on the banana skin and fell down.
lines.chinese: 但为时已晚。Willy踩在香蕉皮上滑倒了。

lines.speaker: Willy
lines.english: Ouch!
lines.chinese: 哎哟！

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: Oh no! I'm so sorry, Willy.
lines.chinese: 哦不！Willy，真的很抱歉。

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: Are you OK, Willy? Let me help you up.
lines.chinese: Willy，你没事吧？我来扶你起来。

lines.speaker: Willy
lines.english: Thank you. My arm hurts a little.
lines.chinese: 谢谢你。我的胳膊有点疼。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: I shouldn't throw rubbish on the ground.
lines.chinese: 我不应该把垃圾扔在地上。

lines.speaker: Tina
lines.english: We should keep our city clean.
lines.chinese: 我们应该保持城市清洁。

lines.speaker: Bobby
lines.english: I'll never do that again.
lines.chinese: 我再也不会那样做了。
